sentences.text:
Author: Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
Bench: Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
 Criminal Petition No.2581 of 2020
Order:
This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. seeking quash of the F.I.R. in Crime No.176 of 2019 of Martur Police Station, Prakasam District.

2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the respondent-State.
3.

A case under Sections 188 and 273 of IPC and Sections 59 and 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act was registered against the petitioners and they are facing prosecution for the aforesaid offences in the above crime.

4. When the matter is take-up for hearing, both the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the respondent-State would submit that the matter is squarely covered by the earlier orders of this Court, wherein this Court has quashed the proceedings initiated based on the similar facts of this case.
They have also produced the copies of the orders of this Court passed in Crl.P.No.3205 of 2019 dated 10.06.2019 and Crl.P.No.2366 of 2019 dated 15.04.2019.

As can be seen from the aforesaid two orders, this Court quashed the proceedings of the case initiated on the similar set of facts under Sections 188 and 273 of IPC and also under the Food Safety and Standards Act.

5. Therefore, in view of the aforesaid orders of this Court, this matter is squarely covered by the said orders and the prosecution launched against the petitioners in the above Crime No.176 of 2019 of Martur Police Station, Prakasam District, under Sections 188 and 273 of IPC and Sections 59 and 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, are also liable to be quashed.
6. In the result, the Criminal Petition is allowed.
The proceedings in Crime No.176 of 2019 of Martur Police Station, Prakasam District, initiated against the petitioners, are hereby quashed.
Consequently, miscellaneous applications, pending if any, shall also stand closed.
